goal: Implement user-controlled local backup and safe previewed merge restore, preserving notes, drafts, categories, recycle bin and disabled reminder configurations.
scope: Only /Users/orderly_ray/Projects/thinkV2 after commander acceptance of reminder stage. Implement PM C1-C10 in the approved product baseline.
User-initiated export/import using Android system file selection. Clearly explain private plaintext data, recommend local folder, no automatic upload/sync.

Versioned JSON envelope and exact-byte payload/hash validation per C2. Consistent database snapshot includes current notes/drafts/categories/trash/title ownership/revisions/reminder settings; future relations empty until implemented, no audio/logs/secrets.
Bound parsing before persistence: file/payload/depth/count limits, strict types/schema/IDs/references/date/reminder validation; reject malformed/unsupported input without truncation or data loss.

Preview counts and conflicts before any write. Merge only: preserve existing local record, conflict copy gets new mapped ID or user skips it; no silent timestamp winner. Map references consistently, no category-name auto-merge.

Single transaction apply, revalidate preview against current database state, idempotent exportId/hash import; conflicting exportId rejected. Imported reminders disabled and do not schedule notifications.
Accessible export/restore UI with cancel/error/retry, no false success or sensitive diagnostics. Synthetic host tests and actual Android file workflow evidence.
out_of_scope: No whole-database overwrite, automatic sync, encryption claim for base64, audio export, private real records, permanent delete, new cloud account or public release.
No ASR, calendar import, AI or graph implementation; preserve later roadmap.
acceptance: Export then restore into an empty test database preserves all relevant fields and identities; current source database unchanged.
Conflict merge preserves local version and maps copies/references; repeat same import creates no duplicates; invalid exportId reuse rejected.
Preview does not mutate database or schedule alarms; changed local state forces re-preview; imported reminders remain disabled.
Truncation/hash corruption/unknown schema/duplicate IDs/dangling references/limits and injected transaction failure leave prior database and schedules unchanged.
Android file picker, cancel, successful local write/read and error behavior have recorded evidence; device-only gaps listed honestly.
User-visible privacy/plaintext and local provider guidance match actual behavior; no private text logging.
evidence_required: RESULT; fixed baseline/final commit; C1-C10 evidence mapping; test logs and fixture provenance; Android file flow evidence; APK hash; unverified items.
stop_conditions: Draft only; execute only after explicit commander dispatch and previous stage acceptance.
Potential data corruption, unreviewed dependency, scope or permission issue stops affected action; no automatic next task.
